CLINICAL FEATURES OF RAPE
Clinical Features
- Indirect presentation
- Vague symptoms
- Physical features:
  · Perineal pain
  · Bleeding per vaginum
  · Bruised perineum, face/body
  · Arthritis
  · Disordered gait
  · Hymen tear
- Psychological symptoms/disorders
  · Sadness
  · Depression
  · Refusal to respond to simple questions
  · Avoidance of eye contact
  · School/work absenteeism
